records.cueHe: פריך רב אחאי: מה להנך, שכן אין ראשן ארוך?
records.about: the paradigm can be refuted, since all three named species share the further feature of not having long heads

records.cueHe: וכי תימא: כיון דשוו בארבע סימנין מייתינן ולא פרכינן – אי הכי
records.about: the defence that anything sharing the four signs is included without refutation would make the explicit mention of ḥargol unnecessary

records.cueHe: אלא, איכא למיפרך: מה להנך שכן אין להן זנב
records.about: why ḥargol had to be written explicitly: from arbeh and solam alone the inclusion could be refuted, since neither has a tail

records.cueHe: אלא אמר רב אחאי: סלעם יתירא הוא
records.about: the long-headed grasshopper is derived not from the paradigm but from the redundancy of solam

records.cueHe: אם אינו ענין לגופו – תנהו ענין לראשו ארוך
records.about: since solam is not needed for itself, apply it to the long-headed grasshopper

records.cueHe: פשיט רב אחאי
records.about: Rav Aḥai resolves the dilemmas from the mishna's passive wording: compulsion on her side still obligates him

records.cueHe: לא נשאו לא קתני, אלא לא נישאו
records.about: the mishna says 'they (the women) were not married', not 'they (the men) did not marry'

records.cueHe: לעולם אימא לך
records.about: Rav Ashi dismisses the inference from the passive wording: the mishna speaks of grooms delaying

records.cueHe: פריך רב אחאי
records.about: the chuppa argument fails: he may pay her lost wages, or bring her at night or on Shabbat/festivals

records.about: bachelor not believed, married man believed

records.cueHe: פריך רב אחאי: אטו כולהו נשי דינא גמירי
records.about: not all women know the law; here too she fears liability
